Final Per-Group Release Table

Source: R/profile_release.R
profile_release.Rd

Combines profile_define_cohort's pre-fit support tier with every post-fit check this family produces – profile_check_sampler, profile_ppc, profile_validate_masked/profile_validate_heldout, profile_sensitivity – into one per-group table, WITHOUT collapsing any of them into a single trust label. Every post-fit argument is optional and independently NULL-able: a check that was not run is reported as NA/"not_evaluated", never silently omitted or inferred.

Usage

profile_release(
  cohort_manifest,
  sampler_check = NULL,
  ppc = NULL,
  heldout = NULL,
  sensitivity = NULL,
  manual_judgment = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

cohort_manifest

Data frame. The $manifest element of profile_define_cohort's return value (needs group, included, reason).

sampler_check

List or NULL. Return value of profile_check_sampler (one verdict for the whole fit, repeated on every row – a sampler either worked or it didn't, regardless of group).

ppc

List or NULL. Return value of profile_ppc ($marginal/$pairwise/$complete_profile).

heldout

List or NULL. Return value of profile_validate_masked or profile_validate_heldout (reads $predictions).

sensitivity

Data frame or NULL. Return value of profile_sensitivity.

manual_judgment

Named list (group -> reason), data frame (group, reason columns), or NULL. Analyst judgment, recorded verbatim with its stated reason – never generated by this function.

output_dir

Character or NULL. If supplied, writes the returned table as release_table.csv and .rds.

Value

A data frame, one row per group appearing in ANY of the supplied inputs (a group the cohort manifest excluded but that still shows up in, say, ppc is not dropped): group, initial_included, initial_tier_reason, sampler_status, sampler_reasons, ppc_status, ppc_flagged_checks, heldout_n_masked, heldout_accuracy, heldout_brier, heldout_auroc, max_sensitivity_contrast, manual_judgment_reason.

Details

manual_judgment, if supplied, is recorded as its own column with its own reason text – it never overwrites initial_tier_reason, sampler_status, ppc_status, or any other field computed from actual evidence above it.
